purpose: Separate wind acceptance set for the experimental G1/G7 solver. Frozen before any wind reference output or Dart comparison existed. The no-wind policy in acceptance.json is unchanged.

convention.sniper_turk_direction_deg: 0 = headwind (air moves toward the shooter), 90 = air moves toward the shooter's right (+z), 180 = tailwind
convention.py_ballisticcalc_direction_from_deg: 180 - sniper_turk_direction_deg (py-ballisticcalc documents 0 = from behind the shooter, 90 = from the shooter's left towards the right; air vector = (cos, 0, sin))
convention.lateral_axis: +z = shooter's right; compared value is py-ballisticcalc windage (m) vs SNIPER TÜRK lateral position z = -range * tan(windMrad / 1000)
convention.zeroing: both sides zero in still air under the case atmosphere; wind is applied only to the shot
